product_overview: CarStore Dashboard is an administrative web app for managing dealership operations across leads, clients, quotes, sales, inventory, appointments, finance, and settings. It helps staff track the sales pipeline, convert prospects into customers, and manage vehicle and business records from one place.
core_goals: Capture and manage leads through the sales pipeline
Create and accept quotes to advance deals
Manage vehicle inventory and related details
Track sales and operational financial transactions
Configure dealership settings, users, roles, and permissions

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can sign in to access the dashboard and start a session with their account.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /auth/login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See a validation error
Navigate to /auth/registro -> Enter account details -> Submit the registration form -> See account creation confirmation
Navigate to /auth/recuperar -> Enter account email -> Submit the recovery request -> See the recovery confirmation

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Users can view a high-level summary of dealership activity from the main dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Wait for summary data to load -> See KPI cards, charts, and recent sales
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open a recent sale -> See the sale detail page
Navigate to /dashboard -> Use a quick action link -> See the selected management section

features.name: Leads Pipeline Management
features.description: Users can create leads, update their status, link vehicles, and convert leads into clients.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/clientes -> Open the Pipeline tab -> Create a new lead with contact and vehicle information -> See the lead appear in the Nuevo column
Navigate to /dashboard/clientes -> Open the Pipeline tab -> Move a lead to Contactado -> Enter notes -> See the lead appear in the Contactado column
Navigate to /dashboard/clientes -> Open the Pipeline tab -> Move a lead to Demostración -> Link an interested vehicle -> See the lead appear in the Demostración column
Navigate to /dashboard/clientes -> Open the Pipeline tab -> Select a lead in a terminal state -> Convert the lead -> See the lead converted into a client
Navigate to /dashboard/clientes -> Open the Pipeline tab -> Try to move a lead forward without required information -> See a validation error and the lead stay in place

features.name: Client Management
features.description: Users can create, review, edit, activate or deactivate, and delete client records.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/clientes/nuevo -> Enter client details -> Submit the form -> See the new client in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/clientes -> Open a client record -> Review client details and related activity -> Return to the client list
Navigate to /dashboard/clientes/[id]/editar -> Update client information -> Submit the changes -> See the updated client data
Navigate to /dashboard/clientes/[id]/editar -> Deactivate an active client -> See the client marked inactive
Navigate to /dashboard/clientes/[id]/editar -> Delete a client after confirming the action -> See the client removed from the list

features.name: Quotes Management
features.description: Users can create quotes for leads or clients, review quote details, and accept or reject pending quotes.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/cotizaciones -> Create a new quote for a lead or client -> Submit the quote form -> See the quote appear with Pending status
Navigate to /dashboard/cotizaciones/[id] -> Review quote details -> Accept the quote -> See the quote marked Accepted
Navigate to /dashboard/cotizaciones/[id] -> Review quote details -> Reject the quote with a reason -> See the quote marked Rejected
Navigate to /dashboard/cotizaciones -> Open a pending quote -> Edit the quote details -> Save the changes -> See the updated quote

features.name: Sales Management
features.description: Users can create sales, review sale details, and cancel pending sales with a reason.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/ventas/nuevo -> Select an available vehicle and a client -> Enter sale details -> Submit the sale form -> See the sale appear in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/ventas/[id] -> Review a sale -> Cancel the sale with a reason -> See the sale marked Cancelled
Navigate to /dashboard/ventas -> Open a sale from the list -> Review sale summary and status -> Return to the sales list

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Users can browse vehicles, create and edit vehicle records, and manage vehicle-related details.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/inventario -> Open the new vehicle flow -> Enter vehicle details -> Submit the form -> See the vehicle appear in the inventory list
Navigate to /dashboard/inventario/[id] -> Review vehicle details -> Edit the vehicle information -> Save the changes -> See the updated vehicle record
Navigate to /dashboard/inventario/[id] -> Review a vehicle record -> Delete the vehicle after confirming the action -> See the vehicle removed from inventory

features.name: Vehicle Images and Reconditioning
features.description: Users can upload vehicle images, choose a cover image, reorder images, and manage reconditioning tasks.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/inventario/[id] -> Open the image upload flow -> Add one or more images -> See the images appear in the gallery
Navigate to /dashboard/inventario/[id] -> Review the image gallery -> Mark one image as the cover -> See the cover image update
Navigate to /dashboard/inventario/[id] -> Review the image gallery -> Reorder images -> See the gallery order change
Navigate to /dashboard/inventario/[id] -> Open the reconditioning section -> Add a task -> Complete the task -> See the task marked Completed and the vehicle cost summary update

features.name: Appointments Calendar
features.description: Users can create, reschedule, and delete appointments for test drives, services, and deliveries.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/agenda -> Open an available time slot -> Create an appointment with vehicle and participant details -> See the appointment appear on the calendar
Navigate to /dashboard/agenda -> Drag an existing appointment to a new time -> See the appointment update to the new schedule
Navigate to /dashboard/agenda -> Open an appointment -> Delete the appointment -> See the event removed from the calendar
Navigate to /dashboard/agenda -> Try to schedule an appointment in an occupied slot -> See a scheduling conflict message

features.name: Finance Tracking
features.description: Admins can review financial summaries, create transactions, and manage transaction categories.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/finanzas -> Review the financial summary -> See income, expenses, balance, and entry count
Navigate to /dashboard/finanzas -> Create a new transaction -> Enter transaction details and category -> Submit the form -> See the transaction in the list
Navigate to /dashboard/finanzas -> Create a transaction category -> Save the category -> See the new category available for selection
Navigate to /dashboard/finanzas -> Edit or delete a transaction or category -> Confirm the action -> See the updated financial data

features.name: Settings, Users, and Permissions
features.description: Users with sufficient access can update dealer settings, manage user accounts, and assign roles and permissions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/configuracion -> Open dealer settings -> Update branding or contact details -> Save the changes -> See the updated settings applied
Navigate to /dashboard/configuracion -> Open the Users tab -> Create a new user -> See the user added to the list
Navigate to /dashboard/configuracion -> Open a user record -> Assign a role and permissions -> Save the changes -> See the updated access configuration
Navigate to /dashboard/configuracion -> Open the profile tab -> Update personal details -> Save the changes -> See the updated profile information

features.name: Reports
features.description: Users can open the reports area to review business analytics and aggregated performance data.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/reports -> Wait for the reports view to load -> See available analytics sections
Navigate to /dashboard/reports -> Review a report section -> Observe summarized performance metrics -> Return to the reports overview

Link interested vehicle to the lead
